description.p: Orca is a production-grade Linux file manager built with Rust and GTK4. It provides a dual-pane browser with tabs, an integrated encrypted vault system, a sandboxed Lua plugin API, and deep customization via TOML config and CSS themes.

ul.li: Dual-pane browser with tabs and three view modes (list, icon, detail)
Encrypted vaults: age encryption, Argon2id key derivation, auto-lock
Ripgrep-backed content search with glob and regex support
Archive support: zip, tar.gz, tar.xz, tar.bz2
Git status badges, disk usage visualizer, mount manager
SFTP/FTP network locations with keyring-backed credentials
Embedded terminal synced to the active directory
Sandboxed Lua 5.4 plugin API with hot-reload
